newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia ASX says turnover rose 40 pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia ASX says turnover rose 40 pct in 96.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said on Tuesday the value of share trading on the ASX leapt 40 percent to a record A$186 billion in calendar 1996, a daily average of A$732 million.
"The year was also by far the busiest in terms of numbers of trades executed, a daily average of 18,661 compared with 13,242 in 1995 and just 6,850 five years ago," the ASX said in a statement.
The ASX said the market finished the year with a total capitalisation of A$391 billion, up 18 percent on the year.
"This is expected to maintain Australia's position as having the tenth largest stock market in the world," the ASX said.
The benchmark Australian share indicator, the All Ordinaries index, earlier finished 1996 at a record high close at 2,424.6, up 10.4 percent on the year.
